instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js) files as required by the codebase setup.
Implement light and dark mode support using CSS variables or Tailwind dark: utility classes with #0B0C0E as default dark canvas background.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='deploy-button', data-testid='mode-segmented-toggle').
Strictly adhere to the accent color #6EE7B7 (dark) and #059669 (light). Avoid pink/purple gradients.
Use Lucide React icons for all UI iconography with 16px size and 1.5 stroke width.
Include Sonner toast notifications for actions like copying code, saving env vars, deploying, and changing settings.
